name: redaction
description: Differential corpus for the two TS scrubbers the tier-0 Redaction package replaces: judge's redactSecrets (via golden/dist/judge-redact.js) and `sindri scrub` (stdin mode). Inputs are synthetic and shared by both sides; secret shapes are stored base64, long inputs as recipes; an output equal to its input is stored as a reference to it.
